labels.reason: Historical reviewer: Threshold of >1 exclamation mark per paragraph catches: proper nouns containing ! (Yahoo!, 'Tarzan Finds a Son!'), quoted speech combining multiple voices, colloquial vivid narration ('He went nuts!'), list headers used as rhetorical questions, and investment announcements with genuine enthusiasm. The 2 samples that approach TP territory have 6-9 exclamation marks in one paragraph but are energetic narrative writing, not boilerplate slop.

original.excerpt: [business/a16z] (Paragraph has 2 exclamation marks. Keep at most 1.) From 1932 to 1948, he starred in a series of semi-memorable movies including Tarzan the Ape Man, Tarzan and His Mate, Tarzan Finds a Son! and Tarzan and the Mermaids.
